reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: North Carolina
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant use their status as a victim of domestic violence
    as a rebuttal/defense?

    Statutes encoded:
      [1] NC Gen Stat  42-37.1 (2021) - Retaliatory eviction defense (protected acts within 12 months)
      [2] NC Gen Stat  42-64   (2021) - Affirmative defense/exemption to complete eviction in certain
                                         criminal-activity evictions (Article 7 / G.S. 42-63 context)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic scenario facts (question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

state(north_carolina).
focus_year(2021).

tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).

eviction_action(a1).
action_type(a1, summary_ejectment).
action_plaintiff(a1, l1).
action_defendant_tenant(a1, t1).

% Factual statement from the question:
dv_victim(t1).

% For this question, no additional facts are stated (e.g., no protected acts,
% no criminal-activity eviction basis, no retaliation evidence, etc.).

/* scenario_statement/0
   Succeeds when the encoded scenario matches the question's facts. */
scenario_statement :-
    state(north_carolina),
    focus_year(2021),
    eviction_action(a1),
    action_type(a1, summary_ejectment),
    tenant(t1),
    dv_victim(t1).

/* Helper to retrieve the single scenario action/tenant deterministically. */
scenario_action_tenant(a1, t1) :-
    scenario_statement.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute [1] NC Gen Stat  42-37.1 (2021) - Retaliatory eviction defense
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% 42-37.1(a): protected activities (enumerated).
statute_42_37_1_protected_act_type(complaint_or_request_repairs_under_42_42).
statute_42_37_1_protected_act_type(complaint_to_government_health_safety_violation).
statute_42_37_1_protected_act_type(government_formal_complaint_to_landlord).
statute_42_37_1_protected_act_type(attempt_exercise_or_enforce_rights_under_lease_or_law).
statute_42_37_1_protected_act_type(organize_or_join_tenants_rights_organization).

% Facts that would be needed to invoke 42-37.1 (not present in the scenario):
% - protected_act_occurred(Tenant, ActType).
% - months_between_protected_act_and_filing(Action, Months).
% - landlord_knew_residence_in_household(Landlord, Tenant). (explicitly or implicitly known)
%
% We still encode the legal thresholds.

% 42-37.1(b): In a summary ejectment action, tenant may raise affirmative defense of retaliatory eviction
% by presenting evidence landlord's action is substantially in response to protected act within 12 months.
statute_42_37_1_retaliatory_eviction_defense_available(Action, Tenant) :-
    action_type(Action, summary_ejectment),
    action_plaintiff(Action, Landlord),
    action_defendant_tenant(Action, Tenant),
    landlord_knew_residence_in_household(Landlord, Tenant),
    protected_act_occurred(Tenant, ActType),
    statute_42_37_1_protected_act_type(ActType),
    months_between_protected_act_and_filing(Action, Months),
    Months =< 12,
    landlord_action_substantially_in_response_to_protected_act(Action, Tenant),
    \+ statute_42_37_1_landlord_prevails_exception(Action, Tenant).

% 42-37.1(c): notwithstanding (a) and (b), landlord may prevail if one of the exceptions applies.
statute_42_37_1_landlord_prevails_exception(Action, Tenant) :-
    exception_42_37_1_c1_tenant_breached_rent_or_other_substantial_covenant(Action, Tenant).
statute_42_37_1_landlord_prevails_exception(Action, Tenant) :-
    exception_42_37_1_c2_holdover_after_expiration_no_renewal(Action, Tenant).
statute_42_37_1_landlord_prevails_exception(Action, Tenant) :-
    exception_42_37_1_c3_condition_caused_by_tenant_or_household_or_guests(Action, Tenant).
statute_42_37_1_landlord_prevails_exception(Action, Tenant) :-
    exception_42_37_1_c4_code_compliance_requires_demolition_or_major_work_displacing(Action, Tenant).
statute_42_37_1_landlord_prevails_exception(Action, Tenant) :-
    exception_42_37_1_c5_notice_to_quit_delivered_before_protected_activity(Action, Tenant).
statute_42_37_1_landlord_prevails_exception(Action, Tenant) :-
    exception_42_37_1_c6_end_of_term_landlord_good_faith_recover_for_own_abode_or_major_work_or_withdraw_6_months(Action, Tenant).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute [2] NC Gen Stat  42-64 (2021) - Defense/exemption to complete eviction
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% 42-64 applies to complete eviction "pursuant to G.S. 42-63(a)" (criminal activity evictions).
% We encode the structure; scenario provides no such facts.

statute_42_64_affirmative_defense_to_complete_eviction(Action, Tenant) :-
    action_under_gs_42_63a(Action),
    complete_eviction_sought(Action),
    action_defendant_tenant(Action, Tenant),
    tenant_not_involved_in_criminal_activity(Action, Tenant),
    (   statute_42_64_a1_tenant_did_not_know_or_have_reason(Action, Tenant)
    ;   statute_42_64_a2_tenant_did_everything_reasonably_expected(Action, Tenant)
    ).

statute_42_64_a1_tenant_did_not_know_or_have_reason(Action, Tenant) :-
    tenant_did_not_know_or_have_reason_to_know_criminal_activity(Action, Tenant).

statute_42_64_a2_tenant_did_everything_reasonably_expected(Action, Tenant) :-
    tenant_did_everything_reasonably_expected_to_prevent_criminal_activity(Action, Tenant).

% 42-64(c): exemption even where grounds for complete eviction established, if serious injustice, etc.
statute_42_64_exemption_to_complete_eviction(Action, Tenant) :-
    grounds_for_complete_eviction_established(Action),
    action_defendant_tenant(Action, Tenant),
    court_clearly_convinced_immediate_eviction_serious_injustice(Action, Tenant),
    serious_injustice_overrides_need_to_protect_others(Action).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Core reasoning: is there a "defense based on domestic-violence-victim status"?
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* The question asks whether DV-victim status itself can be used as a rebuttal/defense.
   We model that as: a statutory defense whose triggering condition includes dv_victim(Tenant)
   as a required element.

   Under the provided statutes:
     - 42-37.1 is triggered by protected housing-rights activities, not DV-victim status.
     - 42-64 is tied to criminal-activity evictions (G.S. 42-63) and tenant knowledge/prevention
       and serious-injustice findings, not DV-victim status by itself.

   Therefore, this predicate will only succeed if some encoded statute explicitly uses dv_victim/1
   as an element (none do in this program).
*/
dv_status_is_required_element_of_any_encoded_defense(_Action, _Tenant) :-
    fail.

/* Even if other defenses might exist generally, we answer strictly from the provided statutes
   and the scenario facts encoded above. */
can_tenant_use_dv_status_as_defense(Result) :-
    scenario_action_tenant(Action, Tenant),
    dv_victim(Tenant),
    (   dv_status_is_required_element_of_any_encoded_defense(Action, Tenant)
    ->  Result = yes
    ;   Result = no
    ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Required API predicate: housing_answer/1 (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    can_tenant_use_dv_status_as_defense(yes),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint + required initialization directive
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant use their status as a victim of domestic violence as a rebuttal/defense?
